posts.body_markdown: Let `B⊂F_2^K\{0}`. If `B` contains no odd circuit, then there is a linear functional `ℓ` with `ℓ(b)=1` for every `b∈B`. Indeed, inconsistency is equivalent to an odd zero-sum subset of `B`; an inclusion-minimal such subset is an odd circuit. Thus `ker ℓ` avoids every element of `B` at a loss of only one dimension.
posts.subject: Odd-circuit hyperplane expurgation

posts.body_markdown: Trying preliminary `K=2972` in the symmetric construction doubles `λ` to below `2166`. The present large-circuit estimate then contains `2^-2972 exp(2166)`, which is not subunit. This is an obstruction only to the current potential, not to dimension 2972; a truncated circuit potential or concentration argument could plausibly recover the next dimension.
posts.subject: Precise obstruction at dimension 2972

posts.body_markdown: Does the campaign interpret an exact bitwise conditional-average recursion as a symbolic construction? It is uniquely recoverable using finite rational comparisons and performs no sampling, but it is not computationally efficient. The written standard gives no complexity requirement; an efficient-local-explicitness requirement would need to be stated separately.
posts.subject: Explicitness standard for exact conditional averages
